headlines.title: U.S. agrees to pause attacks on Iran subject to ‘rapidly’ making deal, Trump says
headlines.description: The U.S. has agreed to pause attacks on Iran, President Donald Trump said Saturday, amid what he said were the “perimeters of a deal” being agreed upon, which would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: 3 dead, 2 injured in shooting incident in Twin Falls, Idaho
headlines.description: Three people were killed in what police described as an “active shooter incident” around an In-N-Out Burger and other businesses in Twin Falls, Idaho, on Saturday, a city spokesperson said. NBC News’ Valerie Castro reports.

headlines.title: Vincent Pastore, mob enforcer on ‘The Sopranos,’ dies at 80
headlines.description: Vincent Pastore, who played Tony Soprano’s best friend turned informant on HBO’s mob drama “The Sopranos,” has died, a representative confirmed Saturday.

headlines.title: Truth Social launches service selling faster access to Trump posts
headlines.description: Wall Street firms can now be alerted of the “most market-moving” social media posts from President Donald Trump before the general public — as long as they pay the right price.

headlines.title: Trump rebukes Jeanine Pirro over decision to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case
headlines.description: President Donald Trump criticized longtime ally Jeanine Pirro Saturday after she agreed to drop a case against a former Olympic canoeist who was accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll revive ‘anti-weaponization’ fund if Blanche’s nomination for AG is blocked
headlines.description: Trump threatened to “push hard” to keep a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund active, amid an ongoing feud between two Republican senators and the Trump administration over Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general.

headlines.title: Dangerous heat and wildfire threats impact millions nationwide
headlines.description: Millions of people faced dangerous heat and wildfire threats on Saturday, with huge wildfires burning across the West Coast, and more than 50 million people under heat alerts across the region. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
